---
title: "Architecture"
subtitle: "Package layout and design decisions"
---

# Repository layout

```
pokerai/
├── src/pokerai/           # installable package
│   ├── config.py          # paths + hyperparameters
│   ├── data/              # fetch, clean, tokenize, encode/mask
│   ├── models/            # Bigram + GPT-2 factory
│   ├── training/          # bigram / gpt2 / trl trainers
│   └── inference/         # action prediction
├── scripts/               # thin CLI wrappers (+ Posit publish helper)
├── tests/                 # unit tests for cleaning & masking
├── docs/                  # Quarto reference pages (this site)
├── data/                  # hand text only (gitignored)
├── artifacts/             # tokenizer + models (gitignored)
├── index.qmd              # site home / manuscript overview
├── _quarto.yml            # Quarto website project
└── references.bib         # shared bibliography
```

# Design principles

| Principle | How it shows up |
| --- | --- |
| Single source of truth for knobs | `pokerai.config` constants + `GPT2Hyperparams` |
| Thin CLIs | `scripts/*.py` call into package `main()` functions |
| Fair baselines | Bigram trained only on action-region pairs |
| Mask safety | Prompt/completion split before BPE encode |
| Reproducible splits | `SPLIT_SEED = 42`, `TEST_SIZE = 0.05` |
| Comparable runs | Shared W&B project name `pokerai` |

# Console entry points

Declared in `pyproject.toml`:

| Script | Module |
| --- | --- |
| `pokerai-prepare` | `pokerai.data.prepare:main` |
| `pokerai-tokenizer` | `pokerai.data.tokenizer:main` |
| `pokerai-bigram` | `pokerai.training.train_bigram:main` |
| `pokerai-gpt2` | `pokerai.training.train_gpt2:main` |
| `pokerai-trl` | `pokerai.training.train_trl:main` |
| `pokerai-predict` | `pokerai.inference:main` |

# What is not committed

`.gitignore` excludes regenerated / large artifacts:

- `data/*.txt` (except `.gitkeep`)
- `artifacts/`, `tokenizer/`, `model_out_trl/`
- `wandb/`, virtualenvs, caches

# Quarto site

This documentation site is a Quarto website (`project: type: website`) styled
similarly to other JackJBurleson Posit Connect Cloud publications: UW crimson
navbar, floating sidebar, numbered sections, foldable code, APA-style
captions, and a shared BibTeX bibliography.
